item.title: Forest Pack
item.description: A set of 8 new forest-dwelling animals made by Wolverale12.

item.title: African Pack
item.description: This pack was created by me and my friend Fireplume, and it has a bonus download in it that I just made for it. [African Clawless Otter] I haven’t gotten a pic for it yet btw, but it’s pretty great so it’s a surprise how the exhibit should look like.

item.title: Wild Yak
item.description: Adds the wild yak for adoption in your zoo, an impressively large bovine that lives in the Himalayas. A great addition to any highland or snowy zoo, or for those looking for more Asian animal rep!

item.title: Endangered Animals
item.description: Encounter some of the world’s most threatened wildlife with this collection of critically endangered and vulnerable species. Perfect for creating conservation-focused exhibits that raise awareness about the plight of these animals .

item.title: African Adventure
item.description: A diverse group of iconic African species including predators like the Ethiopian Wolf and Caracal, graceful antelopes such as gazelles and kudus, distinctive birds like the Sacred Ibis and Grey Crowned Crane, charismatic primates including the Ring-tailed Lemur, and unique mammals like the Aardvark.
